scope.selection_rule: P43 global unresolved in original acquisition order, excluding prior P25 screen, P45 first 150 and P44 SG-INV-0115; no reinterpretation of P46 published records as unscreened

policy: The original 500 lead research queue has now received a first-pass disposition in P25/P45/P47 and P44 reconciliation; this is NOT 500 publication-ready verified Catholic sites.
Every P47 record retains source lead and original acquisition order, explicit next evidence gate and unchanged frozen candidate ID.
An institution website or public tourism page establishes at most Catholic identity without separately named and verified building geometry.
A multi-building site, ecumenical church or historical monument may require exclusion or split; no inferred TLM times, pictures, pilgrimage data or title/recognition.
Later promotion manifests own canonical publication; this P47 research-only register never adds a public map pin.
